newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ahold Thai venture to open supermarkets.
newsitem.headline: Ahold Thai venture to open supermarkets.

text.p: Dutch supermarkets group Ahold NV said on Wednesday its joint venture with Thailand's Central Group would open 15 large Tops supermarkets in Bangkok on June 28.
The simultaneous start of the outlets, with total shopping space of 30,000 square metres, fitted the strategy to rapidly expand the Tops supermarket formula in Thailand, Ahold said.

"Ahold and Thai partner Central Group have a goal of 100 new Tops supermarkets in full operation before the year 2000," the Dutch retailer said. Since January, the joint venture has opened six Tops stores in Thailand.

It plans to have at least 40 outlets operational before the end of the year. The 100 stores which are scheduled to be in business by the year 2000 would have a 23 percent share of all grocery sales in Thailand.
The Thai joint venture was set up in 1996, with Central Group holding 51 percent and Ahold the remainder.
Ahold is also developing its Tops supermarkets and BI-LO food discount stores formulas with local partners in China, Malaysia, Indonesia and Singapore.
